findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice short questions for Unit 10 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 51 questions numbered 1-51; by section: 10.1 4, 10.1.1 4, 10.1.2 6, 10.2 7, 10.3 8, 10.4 6, 10.5 5, 10.6 5, 10.7 6.

Covers sections 10.1-10.7 in book order: distance formula, the fundamental law and its ten deductions, allied angles, further applications (quadrant signs, triangle results, r sin(theta + phi)), double, half and triple angle identities, products and sums. All angles and numbers are our own (none repeats the unit's examples or exercises); every answer was checked by computation in Python (sympy, check10_short.py). Book corrections followed: cos(pi/2 + theta) = -sin theta, sin(3pi/2 - theta) = -cos theta, tan(270 deg + theta) = -cot theta, 2 cos a cos b = cos(a + b) + cos(a - b).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
